import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter for the top 10 breeds by number of registrations
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
filtered_data = data[data['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create a count plot for the top dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=filtered_data, y='Rasse1Text', order=top_breeds, hue='SexLang', palette='Set2')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich by Gender')
plt.xlabel('Number of Registrations')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
